name: college-roi-data
title: College ROI Data: 30-year net present value of U.S. colleges and majors

resources.name: roi-by-major-category
resources.description: Cohort-weighted lifetime ROI per major category (FREOPP 2021, LE TEEN aggregation)

fields.name: pct_never_breakeven
fields.description: Share of graduates in programs FREOPP flags as never breaking even (999 sentinel), percent. Denominator is graduates in programs carrying a break-even age.

fields.name: pct_negative_lifetime_roi
fields.description: Share of all graduates in programs whose 30-year lifetime ROI is below zero, percent. Strictly wider than pct_never_breakeven — it also counts programs that do break even, but only in the graduate's late fifties.

resources.name: best-value-colleges-by-state
resources.description: Top institutions per U.S. state by 30-year NPV, resident student

resources.name: out-of-state-penalty
resources.description: 30-year NPV penalty of non-resident vs resident attendance per public institution. All 455 public universities in the universe, of which 445 admit freshmen. The ten that do not (graduate/professional and health-science campuses) are kept, flagged by admits_freshmen=false and excluded_from_named_rankings_reason=no-freshman-admission, because LE TEEN's published named rankings exclude them: rank orders all 455 rows; rank_freshman_admitting is the 1..445 rank over the freshman-admitting subset that le-teen.com publishes, and is empty for the ten excluded rows.

fields.name: rank
fields.description: Rank by oos_penalty_30yr_npv_usd, descending, over all 455 rows (including the ten no-freshman-admission campuses).

fields.name: unitid
fields.description: IPEDS UnitID; join key to institutions.csv.

fields.name: admits_freshmen
fields.description: false for the ten graduate/professional campuses that do not admit first-time freshmen.

fields.name: excluded_from_named_rankings_reason
fields.description: Empty, or no-freshman-admission when the row is excluded from LE TEEN's published named rankings. An editorial exclusion, not a data correction: the row's values are unchanged.

fields.name: rank_freshman_admitting
fields.description: Rank 1..445 over the freshman-admitting rows only (the ranking le-teen.com publishes); empty where admits_freshmen is false.

resources.name: ai-exposure-by-major
resources.description: LE TEEN-derived AI applicability score per major category (exposure, not displacement)

resources.name: institutions
resources.description: IPEDS 2023-24 institution join table (identity, tuition, room & board, median earnings)
